display_name: DURA 多尺度时频修正源域 GPU 训练
description: 冻结原 DURA，使用全窗口多尺度编码、频域瓶颈及逐时刻复数滤波修正，沿用源域校准的噪声门控；无 F、TX、V 或目标训练数据。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 physical GPU7, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7, FP32 TF32 off; source prepare batch 32, train batch 32, ground/scoring CPU 2 threads

data.representation: paired received/clean IQ, per-packet DURA and its estimated physical action
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 8192 source fit IDs exclude RX4/6/8 day3 and 672 source evaluation IDs

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: 672 fixed previously explored source L_s/U_s IQ, not independent of DURA

permissions.claim_scope: F-free and TX-label-free paired source IQ training, source IQ diagnostics; no target score

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen source-only original DURA v1.0 E20/4940 plus independently initialized 117062-parameter multiscale correction with zero output heads
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: frozen_dura verifies original7/63/30, training_F_access false, TX labels 0 and target_training false
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Fixed DURA source-only original contract; no target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 5; no source or target performance selection

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU7, at most one this-run worker and at most 3 total compute workers including others; check capacity; preserve all other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner only for source contract/role mismatch, nonfinite computation, incorrect checkpoint, target leakage or unrecoverable technical failure. Preserve all artifacts.

rows.method: Frozen DURA plus multiscale time encoder, 32-point spectral bottleneck, time-varying 9-tap complex/conjugate FIR and waveform correction with source-calibrated gate
rows.purpose: Train a distinct F-free recovery network at fixed five-epoch budget
rows.seed_notes: New model initialization 2026110612; source fit 2026110611, fixed input caches and DURA seed 2026092701; optimizer ordering 2026110613.
rows.budget_ref: Frozen DURA 266951 parameters plus 117062-parameter correction; 8192 source IDs x three fixed epochs, 5 passes batch32

notes: Original source-only DURA frozen; 117062-parameter multiscale spectral correction initialized to zero and trained 5 epochs with source IQ and DURA guard.

Per-record gate log10(DURA estimated variance / anchor real-IQ mean square) is 0 at <=-3.8 and 1 at >=-2.8; thresholds were chosen from previously explored 672-record source pilot, not independent validation.
Architecture uses 256-to-32 multiscale encoder, 17-bin learnable spectral response, skip decoder and time-varying 9-tap complex/conjugate FIR; no batch-level target statistics.
No F weights/outputs, TX labels, V or target data during G training; inference uses only each current IQ and frozen DURA context.
All seven Phase1 views run and score truth-last regardless of source metrics. Report full 384013 parameters plus DURA physical solving cost.
